Author: Mayo Botic, Ultranova Violet
Name: PF Analysis
Description: Manage your Party Finder recruitment and see who you are playing with. Save duty, objective, role and condition setups as presets and apply any of them in one click; watch your listing and party as it fills; and look up party members' progression and community ratings.
Punchline: Run your Party Finder: presets, party progression, and player lookups.
Changelog: The clears tab is three lists now - First clears, Savage and Ultimates - because a first clear happens once and an Ultimate reclear happens most evenings, and mixed together the second buried the first. Savage reclears are recorded on their own list. Cards lead with the player's own portrait instead of the same boss eight times, and clicking a face or a name opens that person's profile. The rating window after a duty now waits to find out who it can actually take a vote on, instead of offering everybody and holding the ones that did not count. Fixed clear announcements reaching some people and not others - the plugin was tracking the feed by when clears happened rather than when they were posted, and those are not the same order, so a clear posted late was dropped for good on whichever clients had already read past it. Announcements now also arrive at the same time for everybody instead of up to two minutes apart. Fixed "Show names as" being ignored on the clears cards, auto-adjust rewriting a listing into a composition nobody asked for when somebody left, and "You can still rate these" counting people who were no longer on screen.
